intent: Pin this repo's proof-carrying gate to amos-labs/plumbline@v0.7.1 (from v0.4.1). v0.7.1 makes the receipt diff binding HERMETIC: diff_sha256 is computed with user/system git config neutralised and every output-affecting knob pinned (core.abbrev, diff.algorithm, diff.context, diff.noprefix, ...), plus full blob SHAs, so the hash depends only on the tree. Before this, a receipt stamped where the authoring machine's git config differed from the runner's failed with 'diff_sha256 mismatch' even when the content was byte-identical, routing correct PRs to REWORK — local pre-flight PASS, CI FAIL. Diagnosed on NuvolaNetworks/cuspr, where core.abbrev=7 alone accounted for the exact unreproducible hash that blocked six PRs; fixed upstream in plumbline#74 (closes #69) and released as v0.7.1. Backward compatible: receipts without diff_algo still verify against the legacy hash, so no in-flight receipt in this repo is invalidated. CI-only: the plumbline.yml gate pin. No application code, no policy change.

validation_plan.reason: Assert every pin is v0.7.1 with no stale v0.4.1 reference left behind.
A malformed workflow would disable the gate entirely.

validation_plan.command: plumbline gate runs green on this PR under the new pin
validation_plan.reason: A pull_request workflow runs from the PR head, so this PR is gated by the very version it pins — v0.7.1 validates its own adoption here.

execution_evidence.output_ref: All pins updated; grep for 'v0.4.1' returns 0.
Exit 0 — workflow parses; job ids unchanged.

execution_evidence.command: plumbline gate runs green on this PR under the new pin
execution_evidence.skip_reason: Verified by CI on this PR — the gate validates its own adoption.

result_summary: CI-only pin bump of the proof-carrying gate from amos-labs/plumbline@v0.4.1 to @v0.7.1, picking up the hermetic diff binding that fixes the fleet-wide spurious-REWORK bug (plumbline#69/#74). the plumbline.yml gate pin — no policy file and no application code is touched, and job ids are unchanged so branch-protection required status-check contexts are unaffected. Backward compatible: receipts lacking diff_algo still verify under the legacy hash, so no open PR here is invalidated. self_modifying: true — .github/workflows/** is a protected path, so this correctly routes to human review.
